items.title: 71542_Bill Coleman autobiographical manuscript
items.q: Our landlady had a little dog named Foufie

ctx.x: One night we were in Pisa and one of the fellows invited us to have dinner at his place as he was having a party that night. He had

prepared a fried chicken dinner. Our landlady had a little dog named Foufie and we asked our host to save the chicken leg bones for this dog. There was almost a mountain of bones and the next day when we showed them to Fouffie, he ran away so fast that you would have thought he had seen a ghost.

I had agreed to a new contract with the Chikito starting the 1st of December, 1950, so we decided to go to Paris to engage some musicians. We left Viareggio the 6th of October and arrived in Paris the next day. It was quite a thrill for Lily because she had never been to Paris and it was a pleasure for me to show her around this wonderful city. Paris has so many places to go and things to see, which is always amazing and I got as much kicks out of showing Lily what I knew of Paris as much as she got learning…
